# Penang

## Basic Information
- Type: location
- Source: [_id-306_current_version](../sources/_id-306_current_version.qmd)

## Description
Penang is a prominent [Malaysia](malaysia.qmd) region serving as a high-value technology and [GBS](global-business-services.qmd) hub. Often referred to as the 'Silicon Valley of the East', it has attracted significant infrastructure investment to facilitate advanced functions like integrated circuit (IC) design and Research and Development (R&D). Its role is central to the digital economic strategy of [Malaysia](malaysia.qmd) and its positioning within global value chains.
